title: Canonical morphism from the section ring to Proj
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with an invertible module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], put $S=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$, and for homogeneous $s\in S$ of positive degree write $X_s$ for its nonvanishing open. If the opens $X_s$ cover $X$, then there is a canonical morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj] satisfying $f^{-1}(D_+(s))=X_s$ for every positive-degree homogeneous $s$. Moreover, for each such $s$, the restriction $f|_{X_s}:X_s\to D_+(s)$ induces on global sections the localization map $S_{(s)}=\Gamma(D_+(s),\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(X_s,\mathcal O)$ sending $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$.

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-ample-proj-canonical-map-chart-formula to the nonvanishing cover, obtaining a morphism f with the homogeneous fraction identities on all its chart inverse images.

proof.text: Fix a positive-degree homogeneous section s. For every x, the cover hypothesis supplies a nonvanishing positive-degree homogeneous section at x. Apply lem-sc-ample-proj-canonical-map-preimage to f and its fraction identities at x, obtaining f(x) in D_+(s) iff x is in X_s. Set extensionality proves the inverse-image equality. Pair this equality with the already supplied fraction identity.

lean.statement: theorem exists_sectionRing_proj_morphism (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d), 0 < d ∧ x ∈ nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d)) : ∃ f : X ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L), ∀ (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (s : sectionRingGrade L d), (f ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)), (f.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val) (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) s.val (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n ξ.val ξ.property))) • (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≤ ⊤)).op ((s.val ^ n) (n • d)) = (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≤ ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • d))
